message.text: Taken: one Sonnet minion is adding a start beep and a stop beep to the mic, including automatic stops. It is also looking for why the mic turns itself off. I'll report back when it lands.

Landed: the mic now beeps up when it starts and down when it stops, including automatic stops, so you can hear it. The likely cause of it turning itself off is that its audio track dies (Windows sleep, a device or Bluetooth switch) and the shared ux/Dictate code never noticed, so the button kept saying "listening". That is from reading the code, not proven live. The stop beep now fires in that case, so you will hear when it dies.
No worktree: the change was made directly on the main tree, on branch michael/dev, so it is live now. It is edited in `compose.js` but not committed yet.
